title: Notifications to the Auditor Oversight Body
summary: The HGB provision requiring the Bundesamt für Justiz and public prosecutors to notify the Abschlussprüferaufsichtsstelle (APAS) of administrative fine decisions and criminal proceedings related to auditors.
